name: sit_rest_transition_keys_v1
purpose: Replace obsolete flat-perspective descent/rise placeholders using the approved standing anchor and user-approved K06 seated depth authority.
identity_lock: Preserve the approved head/face scale, four-head compact proportions, sturdy legs, shoe scale, continuous navy dress, lace hem, strap, satchel and rabbit identity.
perspective_lock: Standing-to-seated motion changes joint angles and root height only. K06 controls the forward thigh foreshortening and shoe depth; the skirt remains one continuous garment with no knee cutouts or shorts-like split.
generation_rule: Each transition key is a separate complete-character built-in imagegen call. No interpolation, optical flow, part translation/compositing, deformation, morphing or cross-fade.

normalization.method: uniform whole-character scaling plus whole-character translation only
